name: COUCH MoCap NPZ release
license: non-commercial scientific research, education, and artistic projects
citation: Zhang et al., COUCH: Towards Controllable Human-Chair Interactions, ECCV 2022
partial_metadata_note: The official code repository contains MotionCapture/Mode.txt for 120 original and mirrored sequences from one named subject using date-based identifiers. It neither covers the six released subject IDs nor provides a join key for the 485 NPZ files, so it is not used as benchmark ground truth.
label_policy: Only an explicit source-provided target array or an official sequence-to-label manifest is admissible. Filename tokens, pose geometry, chair distance, and start/end boundaries must not be converted into contact or ergonomic ground truth.
